Returns are subject to a $4.99 processing fee unless you chose Return + Shipping Protection at checkout, which waives the fee. Exchanges are always free. You can start your return or exchange online or at a Thirdlove store. If you need more details or help with the process, just let me know!DisclosureBy using this chat, you are accepting and consenting to the practices described in our privacy policy.Agent saidHi!
